title: Add release artifact subject verifier
summary: Release provenance readiness documents release bundle subjects, but artifact digests are not yet verified against produced files. Add a local verifier and fixture validator for release_bundle subjects while keeping signing key custody and transparency publication human-owned.
expectedFailureModes: Release provenance readiness claims subject schemas exist but cannot verify artifact bytes against release_bundle descriptors.
Release artifacts can drift from documented sha256 and size metadata without a local failure signal.
Docs imply public release provenance before signing key custody and transparency publication are approved.
humanEscalation: Human approval remains required for release signing key custody, public key publication, and transparency publication target selection.
nextAction: Implement release artifact subject verification, wire it into release provenance readiness, and update docs/status without signing or publishing artifacts.
